title: Dense sets excluding nested finite-sum windows
author: Felipe Hern\'andez, Ioannis Kousek, Trist\'an Radi\'c
work: On density analogs of Hindman's finite sums theorem
difficulty_reason: The proof builds a set of upper Banach density arbitrarily close to one that defeats every nested sequence of infinite sets and every growing finite-sum window with natural-number shifts. The non-routine obligation is the simultaneous diagonal obstruction: a sparse family of deleted prime residue classes preserves density, while an early shift excludes the zero residue class and a later sufficiently long window uses a nonzero residue as a generator modulo the same prime. The nested sets link these two distinct scales. The complete author construction and both contradiction cases are retained; no external density or finite-sums theorem supplies this obstruction.
